subject: rt-op
title: RT.OP.------INFO.AF.B.
description: Chart on book p. 414 (MID-W-8). RT-OP (reality options) is the subject; INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) is the partner. From the subject: IST-F (isolated focus), SOC-RT-INT (social reality interpretation), LANG-DY (language dynamics) and ALT-D (alternative definitions). From IST-F: HI-P (high purpose). From SOC-RT-INT: CN-INFO (controlled information). From ALT-D: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). From HI-P: TRS (transition). From AFL-DY: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: ATTC (attachment).
